component.name: Kirie
component.summary: Cut a piece out of your screen and mark it up

description.p: Kirie freezes the screen, lets you pick a region, a window or a whole monitor, and mark it up on the spot with arrows, boxes, text, blur and freehand ink. Or open any image in the editor and annotate it there. It runs natively on Wayland: GNOME, COSMIC, KDE Plasma and the layer-shell compositors.

ul.li: Annotate on screen or later in the editor
Arrows, shapes, text, step numbers, highlighter, blur, pixelate and redact
Clean, sketch and ink annotation styles
Copy to the clipboard, save, or keep an editable project
